description: An `if` condition that calls one of electricity-cel's own internal names directly (`__electricity_strict_eq(1)`), on_error: continue. cof treats this the same as calling any other undeclared function -- a CelEvaluationError, caught by the if's own on_error handling, taking the else branch -- and electricity now matches: a direct reference to a reserved __electricity_* name fails the same way, worded like an undeclared-function reference, rather than panicking.

third_party_text.pattern: CEL evaluation failed for '__electricity_strict_eq\(1\)': .*[Uu]ndeclared reference to '__electricity_strict_eq'.*
